id: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit (2005)

facts.text: A spot of Wensleydale and crackers, Gromit, then off to guard the veg patch. Busy night ahead.
facts.why: Not Wallace's words on the opened quote page. His real cheese lines are 'I'm just crackers about cheese' and 'Cheese, Gromit!'

facts.text: Serve the cheese when Wallace gets the crackers out.
facts.why: No opened source describes a scene where Wallace gets the crackers out. The plot's cheese beats are Hutch getting Wallace's love of cheese and Wallace coming round at the end thanks to cheese.
facts.fix: Serve the cheese when Wallace comes round at the end thanks to his love of cheese.

facts.text: Victor's toupee, mistaken for a bunny.
facts.why: It is the other way round. Victor's toupee is sucked into the Bun-Vac, and the 'toupee' he pulls out turns out to be a black bunny.
facts.fix: Victor's black bunny, mistaken for his toupee.

facts.text: Fired out of the breakfast machine.
facts.why: No opened source says crumpets come out of the breakfast machine in this film.

vibe.verdict: The Anti-Pesto van is the right place and the English food suits it, but the cheese cue and a few notes miss the film's real gags.
missing: The giant marrow Gromit grows, squashed when the van hits the cheese tent (competition day)
The Bun-Vac 6000 sucking up Victor's toupee (Tottington Hall)
Hutch shouting 'Cheeeese!' once he has Wallace's brain
ideas: Swap 'Carrot cake' for a 'Gromit's prize marrow loaf' with marrow and cheddar
Replace 'Hot buttered crumpets' note with 'Cracking toast, Gromit'
Swap 'Dandelion and burdock' note for the corrected toupee and bunny gag
Add a printed 'Cheeeese!' stamp on the callout ticket
